pages.title: Euler's Identity
pages.text: $(thing)Euler's Identity$()$(br2)e to the power iπ, plus one, is nothing: the constants of growth, of the circle, of the imaginary, of one and of none, in a single line. Unlocks Euler's Identity.

$(thing)Insight$(): 140$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Euler's Formula, π, Cardinality.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Imaginary Unit, 1 Zero, 1 Unity.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A point at r·e^(iθ) in the complex plane has turned through θ round a circle of radius r. Write how far up from the axis it is, Y.
